parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
CalculateDozingRequest is the request for the stateless dozing (LDR) calculator.

Modes: SCALE and XSECTION only.

NOTE — STRENGTH mode is INTENTIONALLY ABSENT from the `in:` rule below even
though the consolidated design (§3.7) lists three modes. Decision gate G6-C3
put STRENGTH on hold: its formula/direction semantics are not yet settled, so
accepting the literal here would expose an RPC surface the backend cannot
honor. This is a DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE from the design document. Field
numbers 10, 11 and 12 are reserved below so STRENGTH can be added later
without renumbering.

NOTE — mode SCALE is computed in pure Go (math.Sqrt); mst_formula is read
ONLY to populate formula_code and calculation_trace (decision K-16 / G19-SQRT).

parameters.description: Cost period YYYYMM. Empty means "latest period per head".

parameters.name: costType
parameters.description:
Cost type to include. Empty defaults to ACTUAL, which keeps the row count

parameters.name: checkStatusCalc
parameters.description:
Filter by the DERIVED check status (mst_mb_head.mbh_check_status_calc, P10).

Empty means ALL ROWS, including heads whose derived status is still NULL — so
leaving this unset keeps the export byte-for-byte identical to its behaviour
before this filter existed. A non-empty value keeps only heads carrying exactly
that value, which necessarily EXCLUDES the NULL ("Belum dihitung") heads.

The six accepted values are the six allowed by the CHECK constraint
chk_mbh_check_status_calc (migration 000487). ⚠ Only THREE of them are produced
by DeriveCheckStatus today — "Boughtout", "Approved", "Waiting". Filtering by
"Current", "Outdated" or "Rejected" is therefore VALID but returns ZERO ROWS
until the corresponding user gates are decided. ⛔ Not a bug.

⛔ There is deliberately NO sentinel for "only the NULL heads" — that semantic
has not been decided by the user.

parameters.name: includeRejected

Whether to include REJECTED documents in the export.

Default false (proto3 zero value) EXCLUDES rejected documents, keeping this
export byte-for-byte identical to its behaviour before this field existed.

post.summary: ApproveMBHead approves a submitted MB Head.

GrantUnlockMBHead approves a pending unlock request: the MB Head is unlocked and
returns to DRAFT for editing (P10).
RejectMBHead rejects a submitted MB Head (K-2). Reason is required.

RejectUnlockMBHead refuses a pending unlock request: the MB Head stays locked and
returns to the state it was parked from (P10, K-52). Reason is REQUIRED.

RequestUnlockMBHead parks a locked MB Head (APPROVED/VALIDATED) in UNLOCK_REQUESTED
so an approver can decide (P10). Reason is REQUIRED — an unlock reopens content that
was already approved, so the record must say why.
ReturnMBHeadToDraft returns a rejected MB Head back to draft (K-29). Reason is optional; when empty the existing state_reason is preserved.
RevokeMBHead revokes an MB Head.

v1CalculateDozingRequest.description:
CalculateDozingRequest is the request for the stateless dozing (LDR) calculator.

Modes: SCALE and XSECTION only.

NOTE — STRENGTH mode is INTENTIONALLY ABSENT from the `in:` rule below even
though the consolidated design (§3.7) lists three modes. Decision gate G6-C3
put STRENGTH on hold: its formula/direction semantics are not yet settled, so
accepting the literal here would expose an RPC surface the backend cannot
honor. This is a DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE from the design document. Field
numbers 10, 11 and 12 are reserved below so STRENGTH can be added later
without renumbering.

NOTE — mode SCALE is computed in pure Go (math.Sqrt); mst_formula is read
ONLY to populate formula_code and calculation_trace (decision K-16 / G19-SQRT).

mbhCheckStatusCalc.description:
DERIVED check status (mbh_check_status_calc), computed by the backend from
mbh_entry_status + mbh_is_boughtout. User decision K-1 option 2: the legacy
mbh_check_status (field 9) stays FROZEN as the Oracle import trace and is never
written by the application; THIS field is the computed one.
ABSENT means "never calculated by the application" — 207 legacy heads keep it
absent permanently, there is no backfill. Clients MUST render that explicitly
(e.g. "Belum dihitung"); they MUST NOT coerce it to "" or to a placeholder that
reads as a stored value, and they MUST NOT compute it themselves.

mbhUnlockReason.description:
Reason WRITTEN BY THE REQUESTER when calling RequestUnlockMBHead, i.e. the
free-text justification for why the locked recipe needs to be reopened.
Persisted in mst_mb_head.mbh_unlock_reason.

ABSENT means no unlock request has ever been recorded for this head. It is
deliberately NOT cleared when an unlock is granted or rejected — the trail of
why the unlock was asked for must survive the decision.

Rendered next to mbh_unlock_requested_by (43) and mbh_unlock_requested_at (42)
so the approver sees WHO asked, WHEN, and WHY before deciding.

⛔ This is NOT state_reason. state_reason carries the reason of the PREVIOUS
workflow step (principle U-2) and is left untouched by RequestUnlockMBHead —
never substitute one for the other.

v1MBSpinRecalcSkipped.description:

'Spinning' or 'Boughtout', or one whose status is absent, carries an actual
production value that must never be overwritten by a derived one — it is
skipped and reported here so the UI can say WHICH children were left alone
and why, instead of silently doing less than the user expected.

v1MasterOption.description: MasterOption is one combobox entry (code + label) for the MasterLookupField dropdown.

v1MbBatchError.description: MbBatchError records one MB Head's compute failure within a batch run.

seqNo.description: Display sequence number within the head.

mbRefMbhId.description: Referenced MB Head UUID when source_type is MB. Nullable, empty string if unset.

isCarrier.description: Whether this line represents the carrier component.

legacySysId.description: Legacy Oracle system ID for reconciliation.

v1MbComposition.description: MbComposition represents a single composition line for an MB Head (editable while DRAFT).

version.description: Version number this snapshot belongs to.

validatedAt.description: Timestamp when this version was validated.

seqNo.description: Display sequence number within the head.

mbRefMbhId.description: Referenced MB Head UUID when source_type is MB.

isCarrier.description: Whether this line represents the carrier component.

v1MbCompositionVersion.description: MbCompositionVersion is a frozen snapshot of a composition line captured at validation time.

code.description: Unique cross-section code (mbcs_code, max 10 chars), e.g. RND / TBL / RSD.

v1MbCrossSection.description:
MbCrossSection is a master lookup entry for MB cross-section codes
(mst_mb_cross_section).

factor.description: Conversion factor (mbcf_factor), strictly greater than zero.

v1MbCrossSectionFactor.description:
MbCrossSectionFactor is one ORDERED (from_code -> to_code) LDR conversion
factor (mst_mb_cross_section_factor). The operation carries the direction of
the arithmetic and is not derivable from the factor alone.

v1MbLusture.description: MbLusture is a master lookup entry for MB lusture types.

defaultValue.description: Default numeric value. NUMERIC as string, empty if PICKLIST.

defaultOption.description: Default option code, empty if SCALAR.

options.description: Picklist options, populated when type is PICKLIST.

v1MbParam.description: MbParam is a master costing parameter definition (SCALAR or PICKLIST).

numericValue.description: Numeric value represented by this option.

v1MbParamOption.description: MbParamOption is a single picklist option belonging to an MbParam.

pushedAt.description: Timestamp when the push was executed.

previousPeriod.description: Previous period, used for carry-forward comparisons.

v1MbPushLog.description: MbPushLog records a single push-to-head batch execution.

reason.description: Reason captured for the transition, if any.

version.description: Composition version at the time of the transition.

v1MbWorkflowLog.description: MbWorkflowLog records a single workflow state transition for an MB Head.

totalItems.description: Total number of items across all pages.

v1PaginationResponse.description: PaginationResponse contains pagination metadata for list responses.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. 0 means the server default (20).

v1PreviewDozingImpactRequest.description:
PreviewDozingImpactRequest is the request for previewing products affected by
a dozing change. Spin path only.

data.description: Affected product rows (Top-N, capped by the request limit).

totalAffected.description: Total number of affected products, before truncation.

totalLocked.description: Number of affected products that are locked.

truncated.description: True when data was truncated by the limit.

note.description: Free-form note used to report data anomalies detected while resolving impact.

v1PreviewDozingImpactResponse.description: PreviewDozingImpactResponse is the response for the dozing impact preview.

skipped.description: MB Heads excluded from push, with reasons.

needsRepushCount.description:
Count of pushable heads flagged needs_repush — heads whose already-pushed cost went stale
after a later MB Batch run. Surfaced as its own bucket so operators can act on it.

v1PreviewPushToHeadResponse.description: PreviewPushToHeadResponse is the response listing pushable and skipped MB Heads for a period.

bcRecoveryRate.description: Percentage of value recovered from BC grade.

lossPct.description: Optional loss factor (param NON_STD_SPECIAL_PROD, from Oracle CMPG_LOSS).

seqNo.description: Optional display sequence number (from Oracle CMPG_SEQ_NO).

v1ProductGrade.description: ProductGrade represents a quality-loss configuration preset.

hasActual.description: Whether an ACTUAL cost value is available to push.

hasSelling.description: Whether a SELLING cost value is available to push.

hasForecast.description: Whether a FORECAST cost value is available to push.

needsRepush.description:
Whether this head was already pushed for the period but its pushed cost has since gone
stale — the source cst_product_cost row is SUPERSEDED (or unlinked) and a newer
non-superseded row exists. Informational only: such a head is still pushable, and
re-pushing is exactly the remedy.

v1PushableMbHead.description: PushableMbHead describes an MB Head eligible to receive pushed costs for the previewed period.

v1RejectMBHeadResponse.description: RejectMBHeadResponse is the response for rejecting an MB Head.

v1RejectUnlockMBHeadResponse.description: RejectUnlockMBHeadResponse is the response for refusing an MB Head unlock.

v1RequestUnlockMBHeadResponse.description: RequestUnlockMBHeadResponse is the response for requesting an MB Head unlock.

v1ReturnMBHeadToDraftResponse.description: ReturnMBHeadToDraftResponse is the response for returning an MB Head to draft.

v1RevokeMBHeadResponse.description: RevokeMBHeadResponse is the response for revoking an MB Head.

v1SkippedMbHead.description: SkippedMbHead describes an MB Head excluded from the push, with the reason why.

v1SubmitMBHeadResponse.description: SubmitMBHeadResponse is the response for submitting an MB Head for approval.

v1TableColumn.description: TableColumn is one column from information_schema introspection.

v1TriggerMbBatchRequest.description:
TriggerMbBatchRequest is the request to compute cst_product_cost rows for every
VALIDATED MB Head, for the given period, across all 3 calculation types.

jobId.description: Underlying cal_job id created for this run.

successCount.description: Count of MB Heads successfully computed.

failedCount.description: Count of MB Heads that failed to compute.

rowsInserted.description: Total cst_product_cost rows inserted (3 per successful MB Head).

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the run, in milliseconds.

errors.description: Per-MB failure details, one entry per failed MB Head.

v1TriggerMbBatchResponse.description: TriggerMbBatchResponse summarizes an MB_BATCH run's outcome.

v1UnApproveMBHeadResponse.description: UnApproveMBHeadResponse is the response for un-approving an MB Head.

v1UpdateBoxBobbinCostResponse.description: UpdateBoxBobbinCostResponse is the response for updating a Box Bobbin Cost config.

v1UpdateInterminglingResponse.description: UpdateInterminglingResponse is the response for updating an intermingling record.

v1UpdateLookupMasterResponse.description: UpdateLookupMasterResponse is the response for UpdateLookupMaster.

v1UpdateMBHeadResponse.description: UpdateMBHeadResponse is the response for updating an MB Head record.

v1UpdateMBSpinResponse.description: UpdateMBSpinResponse is the response for updating an MB Spin record.

v1UpdateMachineResponse.description: UpdateMachineResponse is the response for updating a machine.

v1UpdateMbCompositionResponse.description: UpdateMbCompositionResponse is the response for updating an MB composition line.

v1UpdateMbCrossSectionFactorResponse.description: UpdateMbCrossSectionFactorResponse is the response for updating a cross-section conversion factor.

v1UpdateMbCrossSectionResponse.description: UpdateMbCrossSectionResponse is the response for updating an MB cross-section master record.

v1UpdateMbLustureResponse.description: UpdateMbLustureResponse is the response for updating an MB lusture master record.

v1UpdateMbParamOptionResponse.description: UpdateMbParamOptionResponse is the response for updating an MB param picklist option.

v1UpdateMbParamResponse.description: UpdateMbParamResponse is the response for updating an MB costing parameter.

v1UpdateProductGradeResponse.description: UpdateProductGradeResponse is the response for updating a Product Grade.

v1ValidateMBHeadResponse.description: ValidateMBHeadResponse is the response for validating an MB Head.

field.description: The field name that failed validation.

v1ValidationError.description: ValidationError represents a single field validation error.
